صرا (form I)
# صَرَّا (ṣarrā) /sˤar.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of صَرَّ (ṣarra)
# صُرَّا (ṣurrā) /sˤur.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of صَرَّ (ṣarra)
# صِرَّا (ṣirrā) /sˤir.raː/: second-person dual imperative of صَرَّ (ṣarra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
